Every time you react, you hand someone your power.

Kevin Trudeau explains the difference between reacting and responding. A reaction is uncontrollable and often irrational. A response comes from being in control of your emotions and thoughts.

When you can watch yourself like an objective observer, other people can't push your buttons, and you keep your power instead of giving it away.

When did you last react and wish you had responded?

#ad #mindset #confidence #kevintrudeau

Everyone in her office was a jerk, and she couldn't quit.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a caller on his radio show who hated her coworkers but loved her job. He told her to change her own vibration first and look at herself.

A month later she called back. One person had quit, two asked to relocate, and another was promoted. She was transferred to a new department. Kevin's point: she changed herself, and her surroundings followed.

What would change around you if you changed first?
